```python
import requests
from datetime import datetime

S = requests.Session()
API = 'https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php'

def get_last_june_rev(title):
    # Get revisions newer than 2023-06-01 and older than 2023-07-01, sorted newer first, limit 500
    params = {
        'action': 'query',
        'prop': 'revisions',
        'titles': title,
        'rvstart': '2023-07-01T00:00:00Z',
        'rvend': '2023-06-01T00:00:00Z',
        'rvlimit': 500,
        'rvprop': 'ids|timestamp',
        'rvdir': 'older',
        'format': 'json'
    }
    r = S.get(API, params=params)
    r.raise_for_status()
    data = r.json()
    pages = data['query']['pages']
    page = next(iter(pages.values()))
    revs = page.get('revisions', [])
    # Last June revision = the newest revision within June, so take first item whose timestamp startswith '2023-06'
    for rev in revs:
        if rev['timestamp'].startswith('2023-06'):
            return rev['revid'], rev['timestamp']
    return None, None

pages = [f"August {i}" for i in range(1,32)]
rev_map = {}
for p in pages:
    rid, ts = get_last_june_rev(p)
    rev_map[p] = {'oldid': rid, 'timestamp': ts}

print(rev_map)
```

```python
def get_external_links(title):

        'page': title,
```
